confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors rest on crowdsourced aggregators (Expatistan, MyLifeElsewhere, BearSavings) and a 2026 happy-hour guide, so they are medium confidence. Some of those sources are undated, and none gives a restaurant draft beer price, so the beer anchor is inferred from a pub benchmark. midrange_meal_2p is low confidence: no search returned a mid-range three-course price, so it comes from general knowledge. Hostel and hotel anchors are low-to-medium confidence. The dorm sources disagree (about $28 undated with unclear currency, about $35 to $83 for hostel averages), and the hotel sources are mostly converted or undated. wine_glass is derived from the local beer-to-wine relationship because no direct wine price was found. FX: no official RBA observation could be retrieved, so the fx fields are null rather than estimated from third-party market quotes.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used; the anchors are based on Hong Kong-specific aggregated price data. Hong Kong's HKD peg means HKD-to-USD conversion is stable, but the USD values are derived from HKD benchmarks in the window around July 2026.
